note: written before any code of the term and before any kernel / inner number; pointers are to data/advice/gemini_1121/ unless stated; NOTES.md gives the readings

head.class_ids: p49_lib.t49(Cache49, E) (every cache player outside E with >= 20 games, sorted)
head.class_rank: the player's rank in the prereg49 cache
head.check: the extracted rows equal c49_head.npz (Gemini) bit for bit

prototypes.gemini: E only (03 line 517, 04 line 329); the 1,504 are added per PLAN step 2 (coordinator decision)
prototypes.function: p59_lib.prototypes (L2 mean of L2 game vectors, games with a sample)
prototypes.never: an inner player (split v1 inner / inner_keys)

own_left_out.D_table_games: the D player's own head row (03 line 527-532)
own_left_out.inner_games: the inner question player's own head row (NOTES 4)

table.players: D only (coordinator decision; 03 line 548-553, 04 line 358-366); prereg59 used D + E
table.construction: p59_lib.table_counts / table: soft counts q_g[s] at the player's rank, add-0.5 per row, HD group (0, 1, 2+) x player colour; every D game with a sample, once on all D games
table.gemini_difference: Gemini restricted to HD <= 1 games with usable P1 and S0 vectors (03 line 398, 04 line 353); not copied (PLAN: prereg59's construction)

term.question: 10 x mean over the question's games (flat, no (n/12)^gamma)

fusion.form: Z = w_A * log_softmax(Q25 gen_logits with Q25's fold parameters) + w_O * OPP3
fusion.fit: L-BFGS-B, start (0.4, 0.4), bounds [0, 4] each, objective mean NLL + 1e-3 * sum(w^2), no class offsets, no class weighting
fusion.cross_fitting: the harness's 5 player folds; (w_A, w_O) fitted on the fit questions of the other folds with Q25's theta of that fold

merge.colour_centering: B games minus the pool's B-game mean, W games minus the W-game mean, then L2
merge.edge_weight: (S_ij - 0.65) / (1 - 0.65), 0 at or below the threshold, diagonal 0
merge.update: L = L0 + beta * (W_adj * (n / 12)[None, :]) @ L0  (L0 = the step 1-3 log-probabilities)
merge.simulation: 03 lines 591-878 test_c2_3 simulation part with the setting above (Gemini's 03 json 245-273 used the null p99.99 threshold, n_j / 15, beta 0.8, 03 lines 838-858)
merge.pass: 0% repeats: mean gain 0 and min = max = 0; 35% repeats: mean gain > 0

gates: p23_lib.gates vs Q59: G1 >= +0.005, G2 lower bound > 0, G4 single colour lower bound > 0 and B, W each >= -1e-12

seams.anchor_only: w_A = 1, w_O = 0 reproduces Q25's eval / single-colour probabilities
